dominant_strengths: Cohesive purple-to-blue gradient with a moody portrait creates strong visceral atmosphere and brand mood
Floating UI fragments effectively demonstrate 'everywhere you work' product concept through layered overlap
Confident headline typography with clear hierarchy and a tight, focused value proposition
dominant_weaknesses: Too many overlapping UI cards crowd the hero, fighting the headline and obscuring the central portrait awkwardly
Top promo banner competes visually with the main nav and CTA, diluting the primary conversion path
Floating chips/cards lack a unifying grid or rhythm, feeling scattered rather than systematically composed
fix_priorities: Reduce to 2 hero UI vignettes max and align them to an implicit grid for calmer composition
Demote or restyle the announcement bar so the primary 'Get Superhuman' CTA owns visual priority
Introduce more negative space around the headline so the value prop reads before the demos
Standardize card radii, shadows, and chrome across overlays for a more systemic feel
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral pull from the gradient and portrait outpaces behavioral clarity, while reflective payoff is moderate via the 'superpowers' framing.
rationale.intent_fit: It communicates a premium AI productivity suite that spans contexts, but visual overload undercuts the productivity promise of focused efficiency.
